issues.description: The template defines a helper named create_y_state(...) while the problem statement and the reference solution use the name make_y_state(...). This naming mismatch (and the template's NotImplementedError referring to make_y_state) prevents students from implementing the expected function and will cause automated tests that call make_y_state to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function create_y_state to make_y_state and ensure its signature matches the specification (make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None). Update the NotImplementedError message accordingly so students implement the expected function name used by the tests and described in the problem statement.
